group_addVolunteer & Outreach Programme

Help us support local Bristol group sessions, audit venue accessibility, and ensure no one navigating hearing loss feels isolated.

☕

Group Session Host & Greeter

Help welcome attendees to our Bristol meetups, serve free tea and coffee, and ensure every newcomer receives a friendly, supportive reception.

🎙️

Hearing Loop & Tech Facilitator

Assist with setting up portable hearing loops, testing wireless microphones, and optimizing venue acoustics for smooth communication.

🤝

Peer Supporter & Listener

Share your lived experience, offer a friendly ear to those navigating hearing loss, and help connect initiates with local Bristol services.

📍

Outreach & Event Ambassador

Represent the initiative at Bristol fairs, libraries, and venue pop up events to raise awareness and distribute resources.

✉️
